key_takeaways.texte: Emerging markets remained a major growth engine , with 4.4% top-line growth in the quarter and strong volume momentum. Mondelez cited expanding distribution, stable consumer confidence in markets such as India, Brazil and Mexico, and continued category under-penetration as structural growth drivers.

North America improved sequentially, delivering positive volume mix, share gains across categories and strong growth in value channels and away-from-home. Management expects momentum to continue in the second half, supported by disciplined promotions, innovation, price-pack architecture and increased brand investment.

Management raised its full-year organic revenue outlook to at least 2% growth and expects balanced top-line performance across the second half. Full-year EPS guidance was maintained, while gross profit dollars and EBIT are expected to grow in both the third and fourth quarters.

Europe is showing signs of recovery as volumes improve and the company laps prior-year pricing, although the heatwave pressured chocolate consumption and trade inventory in the second quarter. Mondelez also highlighted cocoa-price volatility and Middle East-related costs, but said productivity, AI-enabled efficiencies and portfolio changes should support strong 2027 earnings.
